{{Current events|year=2023|month=01|day=28|content=
<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Battle of Donbas (2022–present)|Battle of Donbas]]
****[[Russia]] claims that a [[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian]] [[M142 HIMARS|HIMARS]] missile strike on a hospital in [[Novoaidar]], [[Luhansk Oblast]], has killed 14 people and injured 24 others, including patients and medical staff. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-accuses-ukraine-killing-14-deliberate-strike-hospital-2023-01-28/ (Reuters)]
***[[Attacks on civilians in the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
****The [[Russian Air Force]] launches an [[airstrike]] on the city of [[Seredyna-Buda]] in [[Sumy Oblast]], destroying a [[kindergarten]] and damaging nearby residential buildings. No casualties have been reported. The towns of [[Esman]] and [[Shalyhyne]] are also damaged by cross-border [[shell (projectile)|shelling]]. [https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/3661217-russia-launches-airstrike-on-sumy-region.html (Ukrinform)]
*[[2023 Iran drone attacks]]
**The [[Ministry of Defence and Armed Forces Logistics (Iran)|Iranian Defence Ministry]] says that a [[drone warfare|drone attack]] on a military plant in [[Isfahan]], [[Iran]], was "unsuccessful" with at least three drones shot down by [[Anti-aircraft warfare|air defense]]s. No casualties have been reported. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/blast-heard-military-plant-irans-central-city-isfahan-state-media-2023-01-28/ (Reuters)] [https://apnews.com/article/iran-government-business-drones-2ea4c51f7be1e377b95d1fccc1c963ad (AP)]
**[[Explosion]]s are reported at [[Islamic Republic of Iran Armed Forces|military]] sites and factories across Iran, including near the capital [[Tehran]]. Videos on [[social media]] appear to show explosions and large fires in the cities of [[Karaj]], [[Dezful]], and [[Tabriz]]. [https://www.iranintl.com/en/202301282372 (Iran International)]
**An explosion occurs at an [[oil refinery]] in [[Azarshahr]], [[East Azerbaijan province]], according to Iranian media. [https://www.urdupoint.com/en/business/explosion-occurs-at-motor-oil-production-faci-1633237.html (Urdu Point)]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**Two [[Israelis]] are shot and critically injured by a 13-year-old [[Palestinians|Palestinian]] in [[East Jerusalem]], in the [[West Bank]] and the attacker is shot and injured by one of his victims before being arrested. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/1/28/two-israelis-injured-in-east-jerusalem-shooting (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.timesofisrael.com/2-seriously-wounded-in-another-shooting-attack-in-jerusalem-attacker-neutralized/(''The Times of Israel'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*British [[regional airline]] [[Flybe]] collapses into [[administration (law)|administration]] with 277 job losses, while 75,000 customers are affected by flight cancellations. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-64436500 (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022–23 West Azerbaijan earthquakes|2023 West Azerbaijan earthquake]]
**Three people are killed and 816 others are injured by a magnitude 5.9 [[list of earthquakes in Iran|earthquake]] in [[Khoy]], [[West Azerbaijan province]], [[Iran]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/1/29/deadly-earthquake-hits-khoy-iran (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Louisville, New York bus-truck crash]]
**Six people are killed and three others are injured in a collision between a bus and a truck in [[Louisville, New York|Louisville]], [[New York (state)|New York]], [[United States]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/6-dead-3-seriously-injured-bus-box-truck-collide-upstate-new-york-rcna68027?cid=sm_npd_nn_tw_ma (NBC News)]
*At least 24 people are killed when a bus plunges off a cliff in the [[El Alto District]], [[Talara Province]], [[Peru]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/peru-bus-plunges-off-cliff-killing-least-24-2023-01-28/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*Three people are killed inside a vehicle and four others are injured on the street during a [[mass shooting]] in the [[Beverly Crest, Los Angeles|Beverly Crest]] neighborhood of [[Los Angeles]], [[California]], [[United States]]. [https://apnews.com/article/crime-california-los-angeles-9aae014fbb6f2edcc54abccfb48a3f66 (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2023 Czech presidential election]]
**The [[Czech Statistical Office]] reports that former [[Chair of the NATO Military Committee|NATO Military Committee chair]] [[Petr Pavel]] has been elected [[President of the Czech Republic|president]], defeating former [[Prime Minister of Czech Republic|prime minister]] [[Andrej Babiš]] with 58 percent of the votes. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20230127-ex-paratrooper-set-to-sweep-czech-president-vote-against-former-pm (AFP via France 24)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2023 Australian Open – Women's singles]]
**[[Aryna Sabalenka]] defeats [[Elena Rybakina]] in the final, 4–6, 6–3, 6–4, to win the women's singles [[tennis]] title at the 2023 [[Australian Open]] in [[Melbourne]], winning her first [[Grand Slam (tennis)#Tournaments|major]] [[Singles (tennis)|singles]] title. [https://www.deccanherald.com/sports/tennis/sabalenka-beats-rybakina-in-australian-open-final-claims-first-ever-grand-slam-1185471.html (AFP via ''Deccan Herald'')]
<!-- All news items above this line -->}}
